_spec: GO-LIVE SPEC — frozen 2026-10-11 (short book slow->hold24 same day,
pre-arming). One Hyperliquid account, two books:
SHORT 'hold24': runup>=12%/4h + first red close + vol>=2x -> short at
close; stop = 4h high (resting reduce-only stop-market on exchange);
time exit 24h. Rule P entries with the 24h hold.
EMA20<=EMA50 bear gate -> long at close; NO stop; time exit 48h;
SHORT book is dial_gate'd: trades only while the trailing 30d mean
24h fwd return of pump events is < 0 with >= 10 events (gate30 — the
dial that kept the short leg out of 2023-24). max_gross_frac caps
TOTAL open notional vs sizing equity. size_pow scales notional by
the Eddie->Harry->Larry dial-up path from super_larry.py.
live:false = dry mode (simulated fills, no keys needed). Going live
takes all three: (1) live/keys.env with HL_PRIVATE_KEY + HL_ACCOUNT,
(2) this file live:true, (3) live/ARMED containing YES.
The bot fingerprints the books section: changes are logged + alerted.
